input: Design a custom cross-stitch pattern from a photo

gold.taskTitle: Design a Custom Cross-Stitch Pattern from a Photo
gold.taskDescription: Convert a personal photo into a stitchable cross-stitch pattern with chosen dimensions, colors, and format.

questions.title: What photo will you be turning into a pattern?
questions.description: Understand the subject of the photo — portrait, pet, landscape, logo, etc. — to tailor the conversion approach.

questions.title: What finished stitch size do you want in squares?
questions.description: Determine the grid dimensions (e.g., 50x50, 100x100 squares) that will define the level of detail in the pattern.

questions.title: How many thread colors are you comfortable working with?
questions.description: Find out the preferred color count so the pattern is simplified or detailed accordingly (e.g., 10 colors vs. 50).

questions.title: Which thread brand should the colors be matched to?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants DMC, Anchor, Cosco, or another brand for the color palette reference.

questions.title: What fabric count or Aida size will you be stitching on?
questions.description: Know the fabric count (e.g., 14-count, 18-count Aida) to calculate the real-world finished dimensions of the piece.

questions.title: What output format do you need for the final pattern?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs a printable PDF, a software file (e.g., for PC Stitch or Pattern Keeper), or a digital image.

questions.title: Should the background be included or left unstitched?
questions.description: Determine if the photo background should be converted into stitches or removed so only the main subject is patterned.
